# Engine specifications

<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs. Do not edit. -->

One page per engine: the decision it supports, its inputs and output, setup, whether it acts or only analyzes, where your information goes, and its limitations and review requirement. Every engine only analyzes: none makes network calls, writes files or changes anything in your tools (checked in CI). Where your inputs travel depends on how you run it; see [what happens to your data](../../README.md#what-happens-to-your-data).

| Engine | Phase | Decision it supports |
|---|---|---|
| [Copywriting](aaj-copywriting.md) | Execute | Is this copy clear, concrete and defensible enough to publish, and which claims still need proof? |
| [Marketing Loops](aaj-marketing-loops.md) | Design | Does this channel compound, how much does the loop lower our effective CAC, and which stage should we fix first? |
| [Marketing Psychology](aaj-marketing-psychology.md) | Design | Does this copy persuade with true claims, or does it use manipulative patterns that must be cut or have a fact confirmed? |
| [Programmatic SEO](aaj-programmatic-seo.md) | Design | Will a template-page build pay back, and how many of the pages we build will actually earn traffic? |
| [Sales Enablement](aaj-sales-enablement.md) | Execute | Which sales assets should we build, fix or check first, given the deals we lost for want of them? |
| [AB Test Significance](ab-test-significance.md) | Execute | Is the difference between control and variant real or noise, and how many visitors do we need before we can call the test? |
| [ABM Program Design](abm-program-design.md) | Design | Can our team actually run this account list, and would it hit the pipeline target if they did? |
| [Ad Creative Testing](ad-creative-testing.md) | Execute | How long must this ad test run to answer the question, and is the winning ad a real winner or noise? |
| [Agent Readiness Audit](agent-readiness-audit.md) | Diagnose | Can an AI agent buying for a customer read, compare and transact with us today, and what blocks it first? |

| [AI Marketing Governance](ai-marketing-governance.md) | Execute | Is our team ready to publish AI-drafted marketing work, and does each citation in a draft meet the rules before it ships? |
| [AI Referral Share](ai-referral-share.md) | Diagnose | How much of our traffic and key events come from AI assistants such as ChatGPT, and do those visits really convert differently from the rest? |
| [Beachhead Segment Selection](beachhead-segment-selection.md) | Design | Which segment, industry or grade level should we win first, and is that choice settled or still resting on assumptions? |
| [Brand Voice Definition](brand-voice-definition.md) | Design | What are the measurable rules of our brand voice, taken from writing we already agree sounds like us? |
| [Brand Voice Governance](brand-voice-governance.md) | Execute | Does this content follow our brand's own written voice rules, and which blocks must be revised before it ships? |
| [Buying Committee Map](buying-committee-map.md) | Design | Who has to say yes to this deal, what must each of them believe, and which conversation and asset come next? |

| [Channel Selection & Testing](channel-selection-and-testing.md) | Design | How much should we spend, and for how long, before judging a new channel; when should we stop early; and which channel should we test first? |
| [Claims & Proof Check](claims-and-proof-check.md) | Execute | Which claims in this copy need proof, consent or a wording change before it goes live? |
| [Community & Dark Social](community-and-dark-social.md) | Execute | Where do our buyers already talk, should we open a community of our own, and is word of mouth growing? |
| [Comparison Pages](comparison-pages.md) | Execute | Is this vs or alternatives page fair and current enough to publish, and when must its rival facts be re-checked? |

| [Objection Handling](objection-handling.md) | Design | Is this competitor battlecard honest, sourced and complete enough for reps to use in live deals? |
| [Paid Media Budget Allocation](paid-media-budget-allocation.md) | Design | How should we split our paid budget across channels to get the most customers under our CAC ceiling? |
